assembly_review.interpretation_limit: Instruction counts and Callgrind Ir explain the observed hot-path direction; they do not prove wall-time behavior, cache behavior, or a gain outside the measured workloads.
assembly_review.measured_observation: The candidate removes the baseline per-sector visited-bit load/mask/store sequence from the hot collector loop, but the emitted loop adds checkpoint state and control: scalar checkpoint equality, counter progression, bound checks, power doubling/clamping, conditional moves and replay branches. The candidate assembly shows these checks in the 0x28c--0x345 loop region; the baseline loop shows the bitset address/bit-test/OR sequence at 0x1c0--0x1fd. The function instruction row count falls 313 to 280, yet measured collector self Ir rises 327,145 (5.871289%) for CFB few-large and 327,970 (5.855415%) for XLS-owned. Thus the removed memory operations did not translate into lower measured work on these inputs; the added scalar schedule and branches cost more in the profiled path.
